description: Arkheionx rule calibration backlog. Initial entries are synthetic/internal and do not represent customer or adoption claims.

entries.title: Negative-context coverage detection
entries.problem: Comments such as missing invariant tests could be misread as positive coverage.
entries.proposed_action: Keep negative-context evidence tests and ensure missing coverage never inflates score.
entries.safety_notes: No private data. Calibration improves defensive readiness scoring.

entries.title: Generated artifact self-ingestion guard
entries.problem: Previous Arkheionx outputs could be read as source evidence on repeated scans.
entries.proposed_action: Ignore generated artifacts by default and report scan source accounting.
entries.safety_notes: No live-chain behavior. Prevents misleading evidence.

entries.title: Report verbosity calibration
entries.problem: Some audiences may need shorter summaries while researchers need evidence detail.
entries.proposed_action: Collect report-quality feedback by output type and audience.
entries.safety_notes: Do not include private report snippets unless authorized.

entries.title: Score optimism risk
entries.problem: Certain toy repositories may receive an improving score despite multiple unresolved readiness gaps.
entries.proposed_action: Collect external evaluation score examples and compare finding confidence against score bands.
entries.safety_notes: Use sanitized scores only. Do not publish private repo names without permission.

entries.title: Multi-protocol classification calibration
entries.problem: Repositories combining vault, oracle, reward, and access-control patterns may need clearer protocol classification.
entries.proposed_action: Track public and toy examples before changing protocol detection.
entries.safety_notes: No live-chain data. Authorized repositories only.

entries.title: Docs/comments false-positive risk
entries.problem: Keyword-only docs or comments can be useful context but should not create high-confidence findings alone.
entries.proposed_action: Continue downgrading keyword-only evidence and collect false-positive reports by evidence source.

entries.title: AMM/lending runtime family expansion candidate
entries.problem: AMM and lending findings exist as knowledge/search categories, but runtime rule-pack expansion needs separate design.
entries.proposed_action: Collect feedback requests and avoid implying full runtime support before implementation.
entries.safety_notes: Future candidate only. No live-chain or deployed-contract scanning.
